name: an-absent-comments-edge-is-no-comments
rule: Meta's (#100) on a post's comments edge means that post has no readable comments. It is not a read failure, it must not make the answer partial, and it must not stop the sibling posts' comments from being reported.
why: T-55, from 83db31e in the node port: an ad sweep with one commentable story and one absent edge made Claude report an error after a successful read of the other post. Graph answers (#100) 'Unsupported get request … does not exist … or does not support this operation' rather than an empty list, and routing that through the permission explainer turns a complete answer into a scary one. The marketer's failure mode is the same one an-ad-with-no-page-post-says-so guards from the other side: being told something went wrong when nothing did, and stopping.

data.message: the post whose comments read normally
